dedupe_keys.name: energypro emd international software for modelling analysing and optimising energy production

description: energyPRO is commercial software from the Danish company EMD International for modelling, analysing and optimising renewable energy production, described as flexible software that helps energy professionals make informed technical and financial decisions. EMD presents it in a suite next to windPRO, which plans wind and PV projects with energy analysis and environmental assessment tools, and vectIO, a web-based virtual power plant that handles daily production, storage and transmission planning with electricity market bidding. Access: sold commercially through the EMD site; the page read shows no price, licence text or download, and the software cannot be tried freely from it. Coverage is generic: any energy system the user models. Caveats: only the company overview page was read here, so supported technologies, time resolution and interfaces were not checked, and it is closed source. It suits capacity planning and network flow studies of renewable plants and their financial optimisation, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
